what_was_attempted: Decompose the cell "VERIFIED as a measurement; not a claim about origins" into evidence_status=VERIFIED plus interpretive_status=MEASUREMENT-ONLY, with the original preserved in status_reason.
why_not_migrated: The decomposition was made and then reversed. This register has no source_id, locator or retrieval_date column, so a VERIFIED row in it is untraceable by construction: the retrieval check cannot reach it and the row would pass every filter and the evidence gate. Before the migration the cell was one of the 53 validator failures; after it, it passed. That is a change in machine standing with no retrieval behind it, which is the one thing the inheritance rule forbids. The row also states a residue - "Some Rigvedic vocabulary has no identified source of any kind" - which constitution section 6 keeps out of the positive column. The cell is restored verbatim and this hold records it. This hold records the row; it does not waive anything. The waiver channel that once lived in this register was removed after review showed it could waive the retrieval requirement across a whole register, waive the override log's own date checks, and admit an ungoverned register. The failure is covered by OVERRIDE-LOG OV-001, which expires. RESOLVED ON MERGE, 2026-09-08: main had already done both halves of this on its own side. 03-REGISTERS/domain-e-hypothesis-eligibility.csv now carries source_id, locator and retrieval_date, so the register CAN record a retrieval; and E-11's cell is a bare VERIFIED with the qualification moved into `reason` and the measurement's sources cited. The decomposition this hold refused is therefore not made by the migration at all — there is nothing left to decompose — and the row is traceable rather than untraceable. E-11 is now in 03-REGISTERS/claim-sources.csv (CS-3187 to CS-3190). The hold's reasoning stands as written and is kept; only its subject is gone. MH-010 is NOT resolved: 03-REGISTERS/HYPOTHESIS-ELIGIBILITY.csv still has no retrieval columns and its three PROVISIONAL rows are still the three failures OV-001 covers.
meaning_at_risk: Whether a residue statement in an eligibility register carries evidentiary standing at all. Typing it to any of the seven values would answer that by clerical act; leaving it VERIFIED would assert an untraceable retrieval.
blocked_on: An owner or author decision on what standing this row has. The underlying measurement is VERIFIED elsewhere, in registers that can carry a retrieval: DME-004 and DME-013 in 03-REGISTERS/domain-e-claims.csv. The likely resolution is that this row carries no evidence_status of its own and the column is dropped from the eligibility registers, which is the same question as D-036 / D-039.

why_not_migrated: Rewriting 1,195 research rows to satisfy a schema is the thing this repository exists to refuse. The cells are left exactly as written and the join expands them; the validator and the generator share one splitter, so the two cannot disagree about what a cell says.

blocked_on: Nothing, and it may never be worth doing. The defect the audit named - several identifiers in one opaque cell that nothing can read - is closed by the join. What remains is a cosmetic difference between old rows and the rule for new ones, and it is recorded here rather than fixed so that a reviewer reading the rule does not report 1,195 findings.

target: 03-REGISTERS/HYPOTHESIS-ELIGIBILITY.csv rows 2, 3 and 4 (HYP-E-000, HYP-E-001, HYP-E-002), column evidence_status.
what_was_attempted: Apply the retrieval requirement to PROVISIONAL rows, not only VERIFIED ones.
why_not_migrated: CLAUDE.md defines PROVISIONAL as supported by a single source or by dependent sources, which is a claim about sources, so it needs one. This register has no source_id, locator or retrieval_date column, so these three rows assert a source-dependent standing that nothing here can trace - the same structural defect as MH-008, found by widening the check that MH-008 exposed. The rows are not re-statused: choosing between PROVISIONAL and HYPOTHESIS for a hypothesis-eligibility row is an analytical judgement about the hypothesis, not a schema repair.
meaning_at_risk: The standing of three of the ten rows in the mandated eligibility register, including the null explanation (HYP-E-000) and the Dravidian-contact hypothesis (HYP-E-001). Re-typing either downward would remove the null explanation from the standing alternative it is carried as; upward would assert retrievals that are not recorded.
blocked_on: The same question as MH-008 and D-036 / D-039: whether an eligibility register carries an evidence_status of its own at all, or whether the standing of a hypothesis lives in the claim registers that can record a retrieval. Answering it resolves MH-008 and MH-010 together.
